evidence: Starting from Whangaparapara Road, the Kaitoke Hot Springs Track begins flat and easy, following an ancient shoreline.
From Forest Road follow the historic Tramline Track to The Green campsite.
You can camp at The Green campsite at Whangaparapara or exit onto Whangaparapara Road.

via.name: Kaiaraara Track

evidence: Alternative access to the Mt Heale Hut is possible from the east, via Windy Canyon and Palmers Track, accessed from Aotea Road at the top of Whangapoua Hill.
This section is fully bridged and is the shortest and easiest option for the first day.
From here take South Fork Track along and down to Mt Heale Hut.

side_trips.name: Kauri Falls
side_trips.quote: a 5 minute detour to Kauri Falls

doubts: The page says the track can also be walked in reverse; the main way is recorded in the direction described. The end ref F7 assumes the 'historic Tramline Track' to The Green campsite is the Tramline Track South that meets Whangaparapara Road there; the text only says 'exit onto Whangaparapara Road'. W2 is the alternative first day from Aotea Road (its 3 hr - 3 hr 30 min time covers only the section to Mt Heale Hut, so time is left null); it is assumed to continue as the main way. 'the summit' on the Windy Canyon section is not named (possibly Mt Hobson/Hirakimata), so no ref. Maungapiko Lookout and Kauri Tree Route are said to be 'on route' but may be roadside viewpoints or short detours; not placed in via. The Mt Hobson summit side trip's departure point is not stated. The Claris ref is for the place, the text names the airfield.
